# zerops_integration_token (Resource)

Manages an integration token using a separate, pre-authorized administration credential. The sensitive token is stored in Terraform state: protect state and backups. Import cannot recover the secret; change rotation_trigger to regenerate it. Rotation immediately invalidates the old bearer. sudo is metadata, not a guarantee of effective sensitive-read permission.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Use a separate pre-authorized administration credential for the provider.
# The token remains sensitive plaintext in state: protect state and backups.
resource "zerops_integration_token" "example" {
  name      = "project-reader"
  role_code = "NO_ACCESS"
  projects = [{
    project_id = zerops_project.example.id
    role_code  = "READ_ONLY"
  }]
  rotation_trigger = { generation = "1" }
}
# Changing generation rotates in place and immediately invalidates the old bearer.
# Import cannot recover a secret; change rotation_trigger after import if needed.
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)
- `projects` (Attributes Set) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--projects))
- `role_code` (String)

### Optional

- `can_create_projects` (Boolean) When omitted, true for ADMIN/OWNER and false otherwise. Explicit false is invalid for ADMIN/OWNER.
- `can_edit_finances` (Boolean)
- `can_view_finances` (Boolean)
- `organization_id` (String)
- `rotation_trigger` (Map of String) Changing this map rotates the secret in place. Do not put secrets in this map.
- `sudo` (Boolean)
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) Operation timeouts. One timeout covers lock acquisition, API requests, queued work and readiness polling. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) Create/rotation-only secret retained across refresh. Null after import until explicit rotation.

### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.
- `update` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import zerops_integration_token.example organization_id/token_id
```
